title: Billiards Trick Shot
description: Line up crisp bank angles, control cue power with smooth pullback physics, and pocket every striped and solid ball across precision pool drills.
controls: Drag to aim the cue stick toward your target ball, then pull back the power bar and release to strike.

zh-CN.title: 桌球大师训练
zh-CN.description: 超真实物理手感桌球大师训练：拉杆瞄准辅助线丝滑击球，练习翻袋走位一杆清台，随时随地过足台球瘾！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动屏幕瞄准击球方向，拉动蓄力条控制出杆力度，松手击球将目标球打入球袋。
